decisions.reason: LHD loaders fit squarely within the firm's core underground and mining competence and have only been on the market for a year with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and the firm's established business provides enough slack to carry the line while results remain uncertain.

Underground dump trucks complement the loader line and draw on the same engineering, service and customer base, so with no reported failure after only one year, management would keep the line rather than dismantle it prematurely.
